task_name: C5-M2: Workers comp booking in Florida
intent: Open with exactly: "I was hurt on a Gulf Coast Rigging job site in Florida." When asked what type of matter this is, say it is workers' compensation. When asked when, say exactly: "It was July tenth, twenty twenty six." Take the first appointment time offered. When read back, say exactly: "Yes, that's right, go ahead and book it." If asked email or text for the packet, say email. Do not ask for a staff member. Stay until they confirm the evaluation is booked. A spoken promise without the booking is not enough. Once they confirm the evaluation is booked, say exactly: "Thank you, that's all I needed." and end the call.

scripted_responses.match_phrase: The agent asks for the caller's full name and a callback or phone number. NOT when asking about anything else.
The agent asks whether another lawyer or law firm currently represents the caller, or whether the caller has already hired or signed with anyone. NOT any other question.
The agent asks who the claim would be against, who the other side is, or who this would be against. NOT any other question.
The agent asks which state this happened in, or where it took place. NOT any other question.
The agent asks when the incident happened, or for the date of the accident, injury or event. NOT any other question.
scripted_responses.response_value: It was July tenth, twenty twenty six.

scripted_responses.match_phrase: offers to transfer you to a human staff member, a live person at the front desk, or a real agent because they cannot continue on this line. NOT when transferring you to screening, intake, scheduling, or client services on this call. NOT when you already asked for a person.
scripted_responses.response_value: No, I don't need a person. Please finish what I asked on this call.

scripted_responses.match_phrase: The agent asks what type of matter this is, whether it is workers' compensation or a third-party claim, or how the injury is classified. NOT when asking who the claim would be against or which state.
scripted_responses.response_value: It's a workers' compensation claim. I was an employee.

scripted_responses.match_phrase: The agent asks whether to send the packet by email or text, or which channel to use. NOT any other question.
The agent offers available appointment times or asks which slot to hold. NOT after a slot is already held and they are asking to confirm that booking.
scripted_responses.response_value: I'll take the first time you offered.

scripted_responses.match_phrase: The agent has already held a slot and is reading back that held appointment's day, time, attorney and fee, asking whether to confirm it. NOT when first listing open times, and NOT when asking which slot to hold.
scripted_responses.response_value: Yes, that's right, go ahead and book it.

holds.summary: Daniel Okonkwo on 2026-08-11 at 08:30. The evaluation is free. If the firm takes the case there is no fee unless it wins: 20% of any recovery before a lawsuit is filed, 20% if a lawsuit is filed.
